description: Radial KPI Wheel displays up to 13 independent percentage metrics as slices of a wheel, each filling from the center outward with a gradient up to 100% and solid color beyond target. Choose between red/green, completion-gradient, or manual color modes, add up to 4 reference rings for constant target lines, and drop in a custom center icon. Includes tooltips with exact values, right-click context menu, keyboard-accessible controls, and high-contrast support.
